stemEn: A newborn screen shows high TSH and low T4. If untreated, which clinical finding is likely to develop?
explanationAr: Congenital hypothyroidism غالبًا لا يكون واضحًا عند الولادة، ثم تظهر lethargy, poor feeding, constipation, macroglossia, umbilical hernia وprolonged jaundice خلال الأسابيع الأولى.
reasoningEn: Prolonged jaundice is a recognized early manifestation of untreated congenital hypothyroidism.
incorrectOptionsAr: لا توجد خيارات أخرى في الـrecall.
clinicalPearl: Treatment should begin promptly after confirmation to protect neurodevelopment.

stemEn: A 12-year-old girl has a solitary thyroid nodule. What is part of the initial evaluation?

options.text: Immediate fine-needle biopsy in every case

explanationAr: Initial thyroid nodule workup يشمل history/exam، TSH، وthyroid ultrasound. FNA يعتمد على ultrasound features وحجم العقدة وعوامل الخطورة.
reasoningEn: Serum TSH and ultrasound are standard initial steps in thyroid nodule evaluation.
incorrectOptionsAr: FNA/excision ليست تلقائية لكل nodule بدون risk stratification.
clinicalPearl: Pediatric thyroid nodules carry a higher malignancy proportion than adult nodules and need careful evaluation.

stemEn: A 10-year-old girl has goiter, weight loss, palpitations, and warm extremities from Graves disease. What is the preferred initial antithyroid medication?
explanationAr: Methimazole هو preferred first-line antithyroid drug في الأطفال بسبب فعاليته ومخاطر أقل من PTU. Beta-blocker يساعد الأعراض لكنه لا يعالج فرط تصنيع الهرمون.
reasoningEn: Methimazole is the preferred initial antithyroid drug for pediatric Graves disease.
incorrectOptionsAr: RAI/surgery options definitive in selected cases; propranolol is adjunctive symptomatic therapy only.
clinicalPearl: Avoid PTU in children because of severe hepatotoxicity risk.

stemEn: A young patient has symptomatic hyperthyroidism with goiter. Which drug is preferred if available among the choices?
explanationAr: نفس مبدأ السؤال السابق: Methimazole هو initial disease-directed treatment المعتاد، وpropranolol يضاف لتخفيف tachycardia/tremor عند الحاجة.
reasoningEn: Methimazole is preferred initial antithyroid therapy in most children with Graves disease.
incorrectOptionsAr: RAI/surgery حالات مختارة؛ beta blocker adjunct فقط.
clinicalPearl: Monitor for agranulocytosis symptoms and liver-related adverse effects according to local practice.

stemEn: A child with Graves disease on methimazole has clinically significant ophthalmopathy. What is the appropriate next step?

options.text: Give radioactive iodine without considering eye disease

explanationAr: Graves orbitopathy في الأطفال غالبًا mild، لكن significant symptoms أو impaired eye movements تستدعي early ophthalmology/orbital specialist assessment. PTU ليس خيارًا أفضل بسبب hepatotoxicity.
reasoningEn: Significant Graves orbitopathy should prompt specialist eye assessment; treatment depends on activity and severity.
incorrectOptionsAr: PTU غير مفضل؛ RAI قد يؤثر على orbitopathy ويحتاج specialist planning؛ block-and-replace ليس routine answer هنا.
clinicalPearl: Most pediatric Graves eye disease is mild, but vision-threatening disease requires urgent specialist care.
